title: Tri-star climber with fail-safe brake, strapped toe plate and mid-spine fold operated at 15 deg lean
problem_restatement: Move a 60 kg parcel up and down residential stairs with one courier, control descent without runaway, carry load with safety margin, and fold flat to van niche with liftable tare.
mechanism_sentence: The trolley walks three small wheels on each side over 200 mm stair noses to lift a 60 kg box with long handles, holds on the edge with a brake that locks when you let go, and folds flat to a 730 mm slab for the van.
decisive_choices: Use 150 mm wheels on 140 mm orbit tri-star to step over 200 mm riser without bridging
Use fail-safe friction brake plus pawl with deadman lever sized to 198 N m hold on nosing
Operate at 15 deg lean against 21.8 deg tip with twin 30x2 mm spine and mid-hinge lock giving SF 9.02
open_question: Will the 6.8 deg tip margin and 226 N heave hold for all couriers with 60 kg parcels on worn or wet stair nosings?
transfer_line: Load: toe plate -> twin spine tubes -> tri-star wheel cluster | Measured: spring detent pin position -> green-red lock indicator

assumed_constraints.constraint: One-person handle effort: sustained pull below 250 N, one-step heave below 350 N, handles 90-110 cm height with closed-loop grips
Folded envelope under 750x550x150 mm and tare under 12 kg liftable by one courier
Van parcel interface: toe plate 450x350 mm holds 40x30x30 to 60x40x40 cm parcels, folded slab 730x490x150 mm stows upright, unfold under 30 s with wipe-clean aluminium and solid tyres

functional_decomposition: Move 60 kg load up and down residential stairs on one-person power
Hold load and control descent on stair nosing without runaway
Carry 60 kg load path through frame to toe plate and handles with safety factor
Provide one-person grip, posture and load retention with fail-safe descent control
Fold flat into van envelope and keep tare liftable while locking rigid when unfolded

concept.working_principle: Three small wheels on each side orbit over each stair nosing so one wheel always bears, long handles lever the load over the nosing, a spring-locked brake band plus pawl holds the carrier on the nosing, twin tubes carry bending to the axle with a mid-spine hinge that folds flat for van stow.

fabrication_steps.description: Assemble the twin 1200 mm spine tubes with the mid-fold hinge and lock indicator
Mount the tri-star wheel clusters with 150 mm wheels and fit the brake band and pawl
Fit the 450x350 mm toe plate with heel stop and harness strap
Fit the adjustable handles and check unfold to rigid and fold to 730x490x150 mm slab

risks.risk: Tip backward on stairs if leaned past tip angle
risks.mitigation: Operate at 15.0 deg lean against 21.8 deg tip for 6.8 deg margin

risks.risk: Runaway descent on nosing if grip released
risks.mitigation: Fail-safe friction brake plus pawl springs locked on release, sized to 198 N m

risks.risk: Mid-spine fold unlocks under stair load
risks.mitigation: Over-centre plates with spring detent pin and green-red indicator, pin stress 36.6 MPa
